subject: Air freight quote: STR to MEL
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the cheapest air freight option from STR to MEL (Melbourne, AU), all-in in EUR?

We’ll deliver to Stuttgart airport (STR) ourselves. The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-27: 2 pieces of laboratory glassware, 189 kg gross, 0.55 cbm.

Please include cargo insurance in the all-in price, on the terms of our frame agreement: goods value 30000 EUR, insured at 110 % of that value, premium rate 0.40 %.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in air freight quote for a specified shipment.
